title: Owlshift ready snapshot
description: What one drain pass read of the ready column.

at.description:
When it was written, at the end of the pass's drain: a step watch
ran in its own process during the pass is behind it.

format.description: The format version of this document.

interval_ms.description:
The watch's interval between two idle passes, in milliseconds: a
snapshot older than two of them is stale.

tickets.description:
The tickets of the column, in the order the drain takes them:
priority, then the first created, then the identifier.

oneOf.description:
A ticket: one of Owlshift's, or, with `person`, a ticket a person
works on, which holds no run slot of Owlshift's.
A pull request Owlshift does not follow.

BlockerState.description: What the tracker shows of a blocker.

oneOf.description: Neither completed nor canceled; or a read that failed.
Canceled or a duplicate: holds the ticket until a person acts.
The tracker knows no ticket by that identifier.

Outcome.description: What the drain made of a ticket in its pass.

oneOf.description: Its intake ran or started in this pass.
A step of it runs as the watch's child: the pass left it.
Its dispatch ran or started in this pass.

Admitted, and not dispatched: why. The reason is the drain's own
(`owlshift why`'s keys), or one only a pass tells: `held` (its last
step left its ticket ref as it was), `next_pass` (chosen, it did not
start in this pass), `ref_unread` (its ticket ref cannot be read),
`refs_unread` (another ticket's ref cannot be read, which stops every
dispatch). The set is open: a reader shows [`Wait::text`].

Not admitted: its gesture is not from an account `admitters` lists
(`not_admitted`), or it carries the exclusion label (`excluded`).

Priority.description:
A ticket's priority, as the tracker reports it. `Ord` sorts the most urgent
first; a ticket without a priority comes last.

merged.description:
Whether its ticket ref records its pull request merged, which
releases the ticket as `completed` does.

ticket.description:
The blocker, as the relation or the line names it: a "Blocked by"
line may name what is no identifier.

ReadyTicket.description: A ticket of the ready column.

blockers.description:
What blocks it, as the drain weighed it: its relations, and the
"Blocked by" lines of a ticket whose intake holds its current text.

drain.description: What the drain made of it.

title.description: Its title, as the tracker shows it: for display only, escaped.

TicketId.description: A tracker's ticket identifier, safe as a git ref component and a file name.

behind.description:
What it waits behind, as the wait named it when told: the blockers,
the holder of a resource (both, when two tickets share it), or the
tickets that held the project's capacity.

harness.description: The harness of a `usage_limit`, such as `claude`.

reason.description:
Why, as a key. From the event log, the reasons `owlshift why` reads:
`blocked_by`, `blocker_canceled`, `blocker_unknown` (its blockers),
`collision` (a resource another holds), `slot` (the project's
capacity), `run_cap` (the machine's run slots), `usage_limit`,
`quarantine`, `pr_cap`, `base_broken`, `in_flight_unread`,
`to_watch`, `no_decider`, `no_intake`, `stale_intake`, `not_ready`.
From the ticket's ref: `needs_input` (its decider's answer) and
`parked`. The set is open: a reader shows [`Wait::text`] for a key
it does not know.

since.description: When it was told; `null` for a wait its ref says.

text.description:
The wait in words for a person, as `owlshift why` says it: for
display only.

until.description: The time a `usage_limit` ends, when the harness gave one.

WaitResource.description: A resource a ticket would take.

oneOf.description:
A zone or a file, as a path of the repository; empty for the whole
repository.
